entries.back_en: Wait, tell me you kept the negatively polarised minerals. Yes, the red ones you found in the generators.
Well... done. What a splendid catch.
I think I'll share this feast with you. Would you... like that?
Didn't those Valkyries give you the same mission?
The beings you defeated in the city are what brought us here. Be very careful; they're more dangerous than you could imagine. There are surely more out there.
entries.note: Minor number agreement but meaning intact.

entries.back_en: It was never said better, right?
